scope: A separate clean environment or independent contributor follows only the public guide and completes the actual core workflow. Record observed effort and failures; customer demand and five pilots are not prerequisites for OSS usability (Requirement N36).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C36-owned implementation, test, fixture, and documentation paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/C36.json to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

results.acceptance: A separate clean environment or independent contributor follows only the public guide and completes the actual core workflow. Record observed effort and failures; customer demand and five pilots are not prerequisites for OSS usability.

invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao owns sealed secret bytes and engine persists only transit-wrapped DEK envelopes.
invariants_verified.zero_telemetry: Enforced; 0 outbound analytical or telemetry network requests during complete lifecycle.
invariants_verified.zero_plaintext_at_rest: Enforced; directory walk over engine and provider data confirmed exactly 0 occurrences of secret sentinel bytes.
invariants_verified.step_up_authorization: Enforced; reveal requests without fresh step-up within 300s fail closed with HTTP 401 step_up_required.
invariants_verified.immediate_revocation: Enforced; revoked member grants are immediately and durably denied (HTTP 403 access_denied) across engine restart and provider restore.
invariants_verified.fail_closed_availability: Enforced; key provider outage blocks reveal with HTTP 503 provider_unavailable and returns zero cached plaintext.
invariants_verified.independent_usability: Enforced; complete workflow succeeds from published runbook without paid accounts or customer pilot counts.
